_note: Picks and one-line descriptions for G2, drafted 2026-11-16 from each place's own website. Needs a human read.

stays.1A Adventure Hostel: A hostel in Lesce with gear rental and organised activities.
stays.Penzion Zaka: A pension with its own restaurant in Zaka, at the western end of Lake Bled.
stays.Garden Village Bled: An eco resort near the lake where you sleep among the treetops, built around time outdoors.
stays.Bohinj ECO Hotel: A large hotel in Bohinjska Bistrica with a water park, wellness, bowling and a cinema.
stays.Sunrose 7 - Heritage Boutique Hotel: An adults-only boutique hotel with 18 rooms in a house from 1890, five minutes from Lake Bohinj.
stays.Gostišče Lajnar: The guesthouse at Soriška planina, just below the top of the climb.

food.Gostilna Lectar: A house with a long tradition in Radovljica's old town: restaurant, guesthouse and museum under one roof.
food.Blejska Hisa: A restaurant built on Gorenjska tradition, open every day from noon to 22:00.
food.Okrepčevalnica Galetovec: A small, homely snack bar in Bohinjska Bela, right where the valley road leaves Bled.
food.Gostilna Batišt: An inn in a house built in 1900, when the Vienna to Trieste railway came through. It was first called Hotel Babji zob.
food.Gostišče Lajnar: The inn at Soriška planina. The last stop before the top.

Q50179542.name: Museum of Apiculture
Q50179542.about: Slovenia's beekeeping museum, in the manor on Radovljica's old square.

Q2049047.name: Bled Castle
Q2049047.about: A medieval castle on the cliff above Lake Bled.

Q2877401.name: Bled Island
Q2877401.about: The island in Lake Bled, with its church. You reach it by boat.

Q12802845.name: Grmečica waterfalls
Q12802845.about: Waterfalls 100 metres off the route in the Bohinj valley.
